theory.intro: The height, the horizontal distance and the line of sight form a right-angled triangle. Mark the angle of elevation or depression from the horizontal, then use the usual trigonometric ratios.
facts: The angle of **elevation** is measured up from the horizontal at the observer; the angle of **depression** is measured down from it.
Mark that equal angle inside the triangle before choosing a ratio.
An angle measured from a vertical wall is not an angle of depression; subtract it from $90^{\circ}$ first.
Keep the full calculator value through the working and round only on the last line, to the accuracy the question asks for.
steps: Draw a diagram and mark the horizontal.
Mark the angle of elevation or depression inside the triangle.

The angle of depression from the top of a lighthouse $48$ m above sea level to a boat is $27^{\circ}$. Find the distance $d$ of the boat from the base of the lighthouse, to the nearest metre.
foundation.solution_text:
The angle of elevation of the lamp from the boat is also $27^{\circ}$, alternate angles on parallel lines
$\tan 27^{\circ}=\dfrac{48}{d}$
$d\tan 27^{\circ}=48$
$d=\dfrac{48}{\tan 27^{\circ}}$
$\approx 94\text{ m}$

Standing $9$ m from the base of a building, Maya measures the angle of elevation of the top of the building as $54^{\circ}$. Her eyes are $1.6$ m above the ground. Find the height of the building, correct to $2$ decimal places.
development.solution_text:
$\tan 54^{\circ}=\dfrac{x}{9}$
$x=9\tan 54^{\circ}$
$=12.3874\ldots$
The height of the building is $x$ plus Maya's eye height.
$12.3874\ldots+1.6\approx 13.99\text{ m}$

[/tikz]
A plane flying at an altitude of $1850$ m begins to climb at $18^{\circ}$ to the horizontal when the pilot sees a mountain peak $2450$ m high, $2600$ m away horizontally. Will the plane clear the peak, and by how much? Answer to the nearest metre.
mastery.solution_text:
$\tan 18^{\circ}=\dfrac{x}{2600}$
$x=2600\tan 18^{\circ}$
$=844.79\ldots$
The plane is then at $1850+844.79\ldots=2694.79\ldots$ m, which is above the $2450$ m peak, so it clears it.
$2694.79\ldots-2450\approx 245\text{ m}$
